title: DrawScore: Evaluating Generated CAD Models against Engineering Drawings
title_zh: DrawScore：依据工程图评估生成的 CAD 模型
abstract_en: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the (k+q)-th power of its size, where k is the dimension of the integration domain and q is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore.
abstract_zh: 自动生成的 CAD 模型通常用体积 IoU、Chamfer Distance 和表面 F-score 评估。但孔位偏移、槽开错面等局部错误虽然会直接影响制造，却因只占零件体积或表面积的一小部分而几乎不被扣分。论文将这些指标统一为积分形式，推导出局部错误的权重随其尺度缩小按 (k+q) 次幂衰减，其中 k 是积分域的维度，q 由惩罚函数决定。基于这一分析，作者提出 DrawScore：将待比较的模型投影为包含可见线与隐藏线的三幅正投影视图，沿投影曲线施加饱和惩罚，使局部错误的权重仅随其尺度线性衰减。受控实验验证了理论预测的衰减阶数；在现有 CAD 生成智能体的输出上，DrawScore 揭示了体积 IoU 评分接近满分时仍存在的局部错误。DrawScore 还可用作强化学习奖励来改善生成结果。对于从工程图生成 CAD 模型的任务，它可直接在推理时核验结果，无需三维真值或额外的奖励模型。代码已公开：https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore。
key_points_zh: 体积 IoU、Chamfer Distance 和表面 F-score 容易漏判占比虽小、却影响制造的局部错误，例如孔位偏移或槽开错面。
统一积分分析表明，传统指标对局部错误的权重按其尺度的 (k+q) 次幂衰减；DrawScore 将衰减降为线性。
DrawScore 比较三幅包含可见线和隐藏线的正投影视图，能识别体积 IoU 接近满分的模型中仍存在的局部错误。
DrawScore 可作为强化学习奖励改善生成，也可直接依据输入工程图核验生成结果，无需三维真值或额外奖励模型。
